layout_notes: Star Mazda (video layout only — replaces zone 7, the Sweeper): the braking zone has two big bumps and the car skips and nearly gets airborne under threshold braking. Turn in after the second bump and start trailing the brake off there.

Star Mazda is extremely tight and low-grip and needs a lot of trail braking to rotate. Very late apex — clip the curb roughly 80–90% of the way around — and no throttle at all until the rotation is done; then feed it in and track out fully.

Transferable principle for the run into the Esses: from Phil Hill's crest the lap is full throttle through the left kink all the way to the Star Mazda braking zone, and a patient, fully-rotated exit from that section is what sets up a flat-out run through the Esses (zone 8) until the fourth S.

source.layout_note: Video layout takes Star Mazda instead of the Sweeper (shorter course); all other corners match the sim 13CW map.
source.title: Buttonwillow CW Tutorial - Tips and Tricks to go faster!

tips: Hands dead straight over the crest
Expect wheelspin at the top
Slight lift to rotate, then flat
Stay off the slippery outer curb
Two rights — stay mid-track exiting
Save room for the fast left
Brake straight, full threshold
Clip all of the left curb
Run out of track on exit
Smooth hands, accelerate through it
Wheels off: straighten hands, don't save

1.character: Turn 1, banked to the inside with a fairly early apex. The road drops into a banked pocket mid-corner where grip comes to you, then crests and falls off-camber on exit, so traction disappears just as you want throttle. The braking-zone curb is slippery — braking on it slows the car worse than the pavement beside it.
1.name: Sunrise
tips: Brake straight beside the curb, not on it

tips.text: Turn in earlier than you think

tips: Use about half the exit curb
Feather throttle — exit falls off-camber

2.character: A low-traction patchwork right-hander climbing a hill — the narrator calls it a mess of a corner. You approach at full throttle and arc gently in; hitting the left curb under braking bounces the car and wrecks braking performance. Brake lightly while still angled, straighten the hands as pressure builds, then threshold-brake at the curb and ride the right curb uphill. Overshooting means too much steering angle and no throttle for the straight after, so rotation must be finished early.
2.name: Off Ramp
tips: Arc in gently toward the curb
Light brake first, threshold at curb
Never brake over the left curb
Ride the right curb uphill

3.character: Entry to the Cotton Corners complex. The video treats Cotton Corners as three linked turns (right, left, uphill right); the sim map has two zones, so this zone carries the first turn and the sequence principle: sacrifice the first two corners to maximise the third corner's exit. Full threshold braking, angle in and clip the curb, but deliberately do not track all the way out — hold mid-track for what follows.
3.name: Cotton Corners 1
tips: Sacrifice this corner for the sequence
Threshold brake, angle in, clip curb
Don't track out — stay mid-track

4.character: The payoff half of the Cotton Corners complex. Stay left after the middle corner — tracking out here ruins the final turn. Use the whole of the wide inside curb (the fast line kicks up dirt there), then late-apex the uphill right by the flag station and feed the throttle down the hill: one of the fastest acceleration zones on the track. The exit curb is slippery and dusty; run parallel to it rather than on it.
4.name: Cotton Corners 2
tips: Stay left for the late apex
Use all the wide inside curb

tips.text: Feed throttle early down the hill

tips: Run parallel to the dusty exit curb

5.character: A long, very fast right-hander (around 100 mph even in a slow car). Enter aimed at an angle from Bus Stop's exit, using the black-marked entry curb under your right-side tyres as the reference. Understeer builds through the corner — manage it with a lift or a light brake drag. The grip lives about a third of the way in from the right edge; further left is marbles and less grip. The second apex is a trap: it sits in a bowl with a divot that unloads the car at speed, so pass a few feet away from it and keep the car flat.
5.name: Riverside
tips: Aim over the black-marked entry curb
Lift, or drag brake, to tuck in
Hold one-third from the right side
Skip the second apex divot
Don't track fully out on exit

6.character: Steep uphill threshold-braking zone — the hill itself helps scrub speed, so brake as late and hard as the car allows, just shy of ABS. The car goes very light over the crest and, done right, drifts in a neutral four-wheel slide over the top. Turning in late or missing the apex curb delays throttle badly, and exit speed is everything: from the crest it is full throttle down the hill and through the following left kink.
6.name: Phil Hill
tips: Threshold brake up the steep hill

tips.text: Brake as late as the car allows

tips: Clip the apex curb at crest
Let it drift neutral over crest

tips.text: Full throttle from crest to bottom

7.character: Not covered by the source video: its layout replaces the Sweeper with Star Mazda (see layout_notes). Deliberately left empty rather than force-fitting Star Mazda content onto a different corner.
7.name: Sweeper

8.character: Fast, flowing esses that are full throttle pretty much all the way through until the fourth S — straighten them out and use plenty of curb, with a slight lift at the fourth before getting back on it. Late-apex the last S; it is the trickiest and the dangerous one: going off there can bounce the car back across the track toward the wall at speed. If it goes, straighten the hands and take it straight off to the right into the desert instead of trying to save it.
8.name: Esses

tips.text: Flat out until the fourth S

tips: Straighten them, use the curbs
Off here: straighten hands, exit right

9.character: Final corner onto the main straight, and exit speed sets your trap speed at start/finish. Threshold-brake to a mid apex and drop into the divot, where traction comes back; the exit then loses grip again and gets slippery on the rumble strip, so the throttle must be feathered even while you track all the way out and use the strip.
9.name: Sunset
tips: Threshold brake to a mid apex
Drop into the divot for grip
Feather throttle on the slippery exit
Use all the road out
